articles.title: Truchet Glass
articles.summary: Curved teal, blue and violet arcs tiling the panel, bright glowing seams between them, glossy and metallic. Reads as a purple, blue and teal mosaic with a pale grid; at distance it is a busy jewel-tone checker with light seams, no single colour wins.

Thin pale-cyan lines trace the tile edges and arcs, like a stained-glass quilt. Colours are flat, no gradient inside a piece. From a distance: Reads as a purple, blue and teal mosaic with a pale grid; at distance it is a busy jewel-tone checker with light seams, no single colour wins.
